The '''Battle of Vinsoth''' was a battle that took place during the [[Ciutric Offensive]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Reconquest of the Rim]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] began to eradicate several [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|vestigial]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] forces left over from the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. As a result, the Empire was led to the planet [[Vinsoth/Legends|Vinsoth]] in the [[Ciutric sector/Legends|Ciutric sector]], where [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed]] and [[Tenth Army|Crimson Dagger Command]] managed to secure an Imperial victory, leading them to pursue other enemies of the Empire to the planet [[Binquaros]] afterward.

==Prelude==
[[File:Ciutric_Offensive.jpg|thumb|left|270px|Following the defeats at Muunilinst and Mygeeto, the Ciutric sector became a rallying point for retreating Separatist forces.]]
Less than a year after the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and the beginning of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], the Empire and its [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]], as a result of vestigial [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] forces left over from the war's end, divided troublesome areas within both the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Brought into a number of [[Oversector/Legends|oversectors]], the Empire targeted these [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]], as well as several [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]], and criminal gangs.<ref name="EGtW" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Empire pressed [[Ciutric Offensive|engagements]] on three fronts throughout the Rim, one of which spanned the [[Ciutric sector/Legends|Ciutric sector]]. Prior to the end of the Clone Wars and the Empire's [[Reconquest of the Rim|campaign]] throughout the Rim, the Ciutric sector became a rendevzous point for the Separatist forces that were forced to abandon the worlds of [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] and [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]] after the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]]. As a result, the Separatists had crossed the [[Void of Chopani/Legends|Void of Chopani]], where they allied themselves with pirates and [[Thalassian slavers/Legends|Thalassian slavers]], which attracted funding from interests of mystery on the planets [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]] and [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]].<ref name="EGtW" />

However, despite their efforts, the destruction of the Separatist holdouts fell to [[Tenth Army|Crimson Dagger Command]], which had mobilized from the planet [[Axxila/Legends|Axxila]]. While the ground assaults against the holdouts fell to General [[Hurst Romodi/Legends|Hurst Romodi]], the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed]] also engaged the vestigial forces, which led them to the planet [[Vinsoth/Legends|Vinsoth]].<ref name="EGtW" />

==Aftermath==
Following the Empire's triumph over the holdouts at Vinsoth, Screed and [[Gender/Legends|his]] fleet proceeded to continue their pursuit of other Imperial enemies. In their pursuit, Screed was led to the planet [[Binquaros]], where the Muun leadership dug in for a siege.<ref name="EGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Vinsoth was mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', a [[2012]] reference book authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGtW" />
